blocks.source: Canto I
blocks.translation: Canto I

blocks.source: Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
blocks.translation: Midway upon the journey of our life

blocks.source: mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
blocks.translation: I found myself within a forest dark,

blocks.source: ché la diritta via era smarrita.
blocks.translation: For the straightforward pathway had been lost.

blocks.source: Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura
blocks.translation: Ah me! how hard a thing it is to say

blocks.source: esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte
blocks.translation: What was this forest savage, rough, and stern,

blocks.source: che nel pensier rinova la paura!
blocks.translation: Which in the very thought renews the fear.

blocks.source: Tant’ è amara che poco è più morte;
blocks.translation: So bitter is it, death is little more;

blocks.source: ma per trattar del ben ch’i’ vi trovai,
blocks.translation: But of the good to treat, which there I found,

blocks.source: dirò de l’altre cose ch’i’ v’ho scorte.
blocks.translation: Speak will I of the other things I saw there.

blocks.source: Io non so ben ridir com’ i’ v’intrai,
blocks.translation: I cannot well repeat how there I entered,

blocks.source: tant’ era pien di sonno a quel punto
blocks.translation: So full was I of slumber at the moment

blocks.source: che la verace via abbandonai.
blocks.translation: In which I had abandoned the true way.

blocks.source: Ma poi ch’i’ fui al piè d’un colle giunto,
blocks.translation: But after I had reached a mountain’s foot,

blocks.source: là dove terminava quella valle
blocks.translation: At that point where the valley terminated,

blocks.source: che m’avea di paura il cor compunto,
blocks.translation: Which had with consternation pierced my heart,

blocks.source: guardai in alto e vidi le sue spalle
blocks.translation: Upward I looked, and I beheld its shoulders,

blocks.source: vestite già de’ raggi del pianeta
blocks.translation: Vested already with that planet’s rays

blocks.source: che mena dritto altrui per ogne calle.
blocks.translation: Which leadeth others right by every road.

blocks.source: Allor fu la paura un poco queta,
blocks.translation: Then was the fear a little quieted

blocks.source: che nel lago del cor m’era durata
blocks.translation: That in my heart’s lake had endured throughout

blocks.source: la notte ch’i’ passai con tanta pieta.
blocks.translation: The night, which I had passed so piteously.

blocks.source: E come quei che con lena affannata,
blocks.translation: And even as he, who, with distressful breath,

blocks.source: uscito fuor del pelago a la riva,
blocks.translation: Forth issued from the sea upon the shore,

blocks.source: si volge a l’acqua perigliosa e guata,
blocks.translation: Turns to the water perilous and gazes;

blocks.source: così l’animo mio, ch’ancor fuggiva,
blocks.translation: So did my soul, that still was fleeing onward,

blocks.source: si volse a retro a rimirar lo passo
blocks.translation: Turn itself back to re-behold the pass

blocks.source: che non lasciò già mai persona viva.
blocks.translation: Which never yet a living person left.

blocks.source: Poi ch’èi posato un poco il corpo lasso,
blocks.translation: After my weary body I had rested,

blocks.source: ripresi via per la piaggia diserta,
blocks.translation: The way resumed I on the desert slope,

blocks.source: sì che ’l piè fermo sempre era ’l più basso.
blocks.translation: So that the firm foot ever was the lower.

blocks.source: Ed ecco, quasi al cominciar de l’erta,
blocks.translation: And lo! almost where the ascent began,

blocks.source: una lonza leggera e presta molto,
blocks.translation: A panther light and swift exceedingly,

blocks.source: che di pel macolato era coverta;
blocks.translation: Which with a spotted skin was covered o’er!

blocks.source: e non mi si partia dinanzi al volto,
blocks.translation: And never moved she from before my face,

blocks.source: anzi ’mpediva tanto il mio cammino,
blocks.translation: Nay, rather did impede so much my way,

blocks.source: ch’i’ fui per ritornar più volte vòlto.
blocks.translation: That many times I to return had turned.

blocks.source: Temp’ era dal principio del mattino,
blocks.translation: The time was the beginning of the morning,

blocks.source: e ’l sol montava ’n sù con quelle stelle
blocks.translation: And up the sun was mounting with those stars

blocks.source: ch’eran con lui quando l’amor divino
blocks.translation: That with him were, what time the Love Divine

blocks.source: mosse di prima quelle cose belle;
blocks.translation: At first in motion set those beauteous things;

blocks.source: sì ch’a bene sperar m’era cagione
blocks.translation: So that I had cause to hope well

blocks.source: di quella fiera a la gaetta pelle
blocks.translation: of that beast with the dappled skin:

blocks.source: l’ora del tempo e la dolce stagione;
blocks.translation: the hour of the day and the gentle season;

blocks.source: ma non sì che paura non mi desse
blocks.translation: But not so much, that did not give me fear

blocks.source: la vista che m’apparve d’un leone.
blocks.translation: A lion’s aspect which appeared to me.

blocks.source: Questi parea che contra me venisse
blocks.translation: He seemed as if against me he were coming

blocks.source: con la test’ alta e con rabbiosa fame,
blocks.translation: With head uplifted, and with ravenous hunger,

blocks.source: sì che parea che l’aere ne tremesse.
blocks.translation: so that the air itself seemed to tremble.

blocks.source: Ed una lupa, che di tutte brame
blocks.translation: And a she-wolf, that with all hungerings

blocks.source: sembiava carca ne la sua magrezza,
blocks.translation: Seemed to be laden in her meagreness,

blocks.source: e molte genti fé già viver grame,
blocks.translation: And many folk has caused to live forlorn!

blocks.source: questa mi porse tanto di gravezza
blocks.translation: She brought upon me so much heaviness,

blocks.source: con la paura ch’uscia di sua vista,
blocks.translation: With the affright that from her aspect came,

blocks.source: ch’io perdei la speranza de l’altezza.
blocks.translation: That I the hope relinquished of the height.

blocks.source: E qual è quei che volontieri acquista,
blocks.translation: And as he is who willingly acquires,

blocks.source: e giugne ’l tempo che perder lo face,
blocks.translation: And the time comes that causes him to lose,

blocks.source: che ’n tutti suoi pensier piange e s’attrista;
blocks.translation: Who weeps in all his thoughts and is despondent,

blocks.source: tal mi fece la bestia sanza pace,
blocks.translation: E’en such made me that beast withouten peace,

blocks.source: che, venendomi ’ncontro, a poco a poco
blocks.translation: Which, coming on against me by degrees

blocks.source: mi ripigneva là dove ’l sol tace.
blocks.translation: Thrust me back thither where the sun is silent.

blocks.source: Mentre ch’i’ rovinava in basso loco,
blocks.translation: While I was rushing downward to the lowland,

blocks.source: dinanzi a li occhi mi si fu offerto
blocks.translation: Before mine eyes did one present himself,

blocks.source: chi per lungo silenzio parea fioco.
blocks.translation: Who seemed from long-continued silence hoarse.

blocks.source: Quando vidi costui nel gran diserto,
blocks.translation: When I beheld him in the desert vast,

blocks.source: «Miserere di me», gridai a lui,
blocks.translation: “Have pity on me,” unto him I cried,

blocks.source: «qual che tu sii, od ombra od omo certo!».
blocks.translation: “Whiche’er thou art, or shade or real man!”

blocks.source: Rispuosemi: «Non omo, omo già fui,
blocks.translation: He answered me: “Not man; man once I was,

blocks.source: e li parenti miei furon lombardi,
blocks.translation: And both my parents were of Lombardy,

blocks.source: mantoani per patrïa ambedui.
blocks.translation: And Mantuans by country both of them.

blocks.source: Nacqui sub Iulio, ancor che fosse tardi,
blocks.translation: ‘Sub Julio’ was I born, though it was late,

blocks.source: e vissi a Roma sotto ’l buono Augusto
blocks.translation: And lived at Rome under the good Augustus,

blocks.source: nel tempo de li dèi falsi e bugiardi.
blocks.translation: During the time of false and lying gods.

blocks.source: Poeta fui, e cantai di quel giusto
blocks.translation: A poet was I, and I sang that just

blocks.source: figliuol d’Anchise che venne di Troia,
blocks.translation: Son of Anchises, who came forth from Troy,

blocks.source: poi che ’l superbo Ilïón fu combusto.
blocks.translation: After that Ilion the superb was burned.

blocks.source: Ma tu perché ritorni a tanta noia?
blocks.translation: But thou, why goest thou back to such annoyance?

blocks.source: perché non sali il dilettoso monte
blocks.translation: Why climb’st thou not the Mount Delectable,

blocks.source: ch’è principio e cagion di tutta gioia?».
blocks.translation: Which is the source and cause of every joy?”

blocks.source: «Or se’ tu quel Virgilio e quella fonte
blocks.translation: “Now, art thou that Virgilius and that fountain

blocks.source: che spandi di parlar sì largo fiume?»,
blocks.translation: Which spreads abroad so wide a river of speech?”

blocks.source: rispuos’ io lui con vergognosa fronte.
blocks.translation: I made response to him with bashful forehead.

blocks.source: «O de li altri poeti onore e lume,
blocks.translation: “O, of the other poets honour and light,

blocks.source: vagliami ’l lungo studio e ’l grande amore
blocks.translation: Avail me the long study and great love

blocks.source: che m’ha fatto cercar lo tuo volume.
blocks.translation: That have impelled me to explore thy volume!

blocks.source: Tu se’ lo mio maestro e ’l mio autore,
blocks.translation: Thou art my master, and my author thou,

blocks.source: tu se’ solo colui da cu’ io tolsi
blocks.translation: Thou art alone the one from whom I took

blocks.source: lo bello stilo che m’ha fatto onore.
blocks.translation: The beautiful style that has done honour to me.

blocks.source: Vedi la bestia per cu’ io mi volsi;
blocks.translation: Behold the beast, for which I have turned back;

blocks.source: aiutami da lei, famoso saggio,
blocks.translation: Do thou protect me from her, famous Sage,

blocks.source: ch’ella mi fa tremar le vene e i polsi».
blocks.translation: For she doth make my veins and pulses tremble.”

blocks.source: «A te convien tenere altro vïaggio»,
blocks.translation: “Thee it behoves to take another road,”

blocks.source: rispuose, poi che lagrimar mi vide,
blocks.translation: Responded he, when he beheld me weeping,

blocks.source: «se vuo’ campar d’esto loco selvaggio;
blocks.translation: “If from this savage place thou wouldst escape;

blocks.source: ché questa bestia, per la qual tu gride,
blocks.translation: Because this beast, at which thou criest out,

blocks.source: non lascia altrui passar per la sua via,
blocks.translation: Suffers not any one to pass her way,

blocks.source: ma tanto lo ’mpedisce che l’uccide;
blocks.translation: But so doth harass him, that she destroys him;

blocks.source: e ha natura sì malvagia e ria,
blocks.translation: And has a nature so malign and ruthless,

blocks.source: che mai non empie la bramosa voglia,
blocks.translation: That never doth she glut her greedy will,

blocks.source: e dopo ’l pasto ha più fame che pria.
blocks.translation: And after food is hungrier than before.

blocks.source: Molti son li animali a cui s’ammoglia,
blocks.translation: Many the animals with whom she weds,

blocks.source: e più saranno ancora, infin che ’l veltro
blocks.translation: And more they shall be still, until the Greyhound

blocks.source: verrà, che la farà morir con doglia.
blocks.translation: Comes, who shall make her perish in her pain.

blocks.source: Questi non ciberà terra né peltro,
blocks.translation: He shall not feed on either earth or pelf,

blocks.source: ma sapïenza, amore e virtute,
blocks.translation: But upon wisdom, and on love and virtue;

blocks.source: e sua nazion sarà tra feltro e feltro.
blocks.translation: ’Twixt Feltro and Feltro shall his nation be;

blocks.source: Di quella umile Italia fia salute
blocks.translation: Of that low Italy shall he be the saviour,

blocks.source: per cui morì la vergine Cammilla,
blocks.translation: On whose account the maid Camilla died,

blocks.source: Eurialo e Turno e Niso di ferute.
blocks.translation: Euryalus, Turnus, Nisus, of their wounds;

blocks.source: Questi la caccerà per ogne villa,
blocks.translation: Through every city shall he hunt her down,

blocks.source: fin che l’avrà rimessa ne lo ’nferno,
blocks.translation: Until he shall have driven her back to Hell,

blocks.source: là onde ’nvidia prima dipartilla.
blocks.translation: There from whence envy first did let her loose.

blocks.source: Ond’ io per lo tuo me’ penso e discerno
blocks.translation: Therefore I think and judge it for thy best

blocks.source: che tu mi segui, e io sarò tua guida,
blocks.translation: Thou follow me, and I will be thy guide,

blocks.source: e trarrotti di qui per loco etterno;
blocks.translation: And lead thee hence through the eternal place,

blocks.source: ove udirai le disperate strida,
blocks.translation: Where thou shalt hear the desperate lamentations,

blocks.source: vedrai li antichi spiriti dolenti,
blocks.translation: Shalt see the ancient spirits disconsolate,

blocks.source: ch’a la seconda morte ciascun grida;
blocks.translation: Who cry out each one for the second death;

blocks.source: e vederai color che son contenti
blocks.translation: And thou shalt see those who contented are

blocks.source: nel foco, perché speran di venire
blocks.translation: Within the fire, because they hope to come,

blocks.source: quando che sia a le beate genti.
blocks.translation: Whene’er it may be, to the blessed people;

blocks.source: A le quai poi se tu vorrai salire,
blocks.translation: To whom, then, if thou wishest to ascend,

blocks.source: anima fia a ciò più di me degna:
blocks.translation: A soul shall be for that than I more worthy;

blocks.source: con lei ti lascerò nel mio partire;
blocks.translation: With her at my departure I will leave thee;

blocks.source: ché quello imperador che là sù regna,
blocks.translation: Because that Emperor, who reigns above,

blocks.source: perch’ i’ fu’ ribellante a la sua legge,
blocks.translation: In that I was rebellious to his law,

blocks.source: non vuol che ’n sua città per me si vegna.
blocks.translation: Wills that through me none come into his city.

blocks.source: In tutte parti impera e quivi regge;
blocks.translation: He governs everywhere, and there he reigns;

blocks.source: quivi è la sua città e l’alto seggio:
blocks.translation: There is his city and his lofty throne;

blocks.source: oh felice colui cu’ ivi elegge!».
blocks.translation: O happy he whom thereto he elects!”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «Poeta, io ti richeggio
blocks.translation: And I to him: “Poet, I thee entreat,

blocks.source: per quello Dio che tu non conoscesti,
blocks.translation: By that same God whom thou didst never know,

blocks.source: acciò ch’io fugga questo male e peggio,
blocks.translation: So that I may escape this woe and worse,

blocks.source: che tu mi meni là dov’ or dicesti,
blocks.translation: Thou wouldst conduct me there where thou hast said,

blocks.source: sì ch’io veggia la porta di san Pietro
blocks.translation: That I may see the portal of Saint Peter,

blocks.source: e color cui tu fai cotanto mesti».
blocks.translation: And those thou makest so disconsolate.”

blocks.source: Allor si mosse, e io li tenni dietro.
blocks.translation: Then he moved on, and I behind him followed.
